pages: Foreground: Elin, twenty, auburn hair pinned back, a bright blue woollen dress, at the long pine table. Middle: exactly four wooden chairs, one at each place, the far-end one turned out at an angle, a dark-haired girl in a knitted vest with her palm on its back. Background: whitewashed wall, a pail. Light: flat grey light through one small window.

Foreground: the headman's hand shaking Elin's hand; Elin, twenty, auburn hair pinned back, a bright blue woollen dress, her satchel down by her boots. Middle: desks in rows, small children standing at them. Background: an open door to a lane, a bare branch. Light: low October sun across the floor.

Foreground: Sorcha, about fifty, a dark shawl over a work dress, sleeves pushed up, setting down a bowl, a spoon and a cup. Middle: the long pine table, exactly four wooden chairs, a long dish of rice pudding along the boards. Background: a black iron stove with its red door, steam. Light: warm light off the hot oven.

Foreground: Elin, twenty, auburn hair pinned back, a bright blue woollen dress, sitting down in the far-end chair. Middle: exactly four wooden chairs; Ilma, about eleven, dark hair, a knitted vest over her dress, and her mother along the far side. Background: the milkman eating off a barrel, rain on the window. Light: grey light off a wet sky.

Foreground: a long dish of rice pudding, a bowl, a spoon and a cup at each of exactly four wooden chairs. Middle: three pairs of feet pushed back an inch and a half, Sorcha at the head. Background: Elin in her bright blue woollen dress at the far end, heads turned to their bowls. Light: lamplight and oven glow. From the window side, the light behind the subject.

Elin, twenty, auburn hair pinned back, in a bright blue woollen dress, holds out an empty bowl in one hand at the end of a long pine table. Middle: a long dish of rice pudding scraped nearly bare, a spoon laid down on the boards. Background: exactly four wooden chairs, one at each place, warm lamplight on the boards. Seen from the level of the table.

Sorcha, about fifty, white hair under a dark shawl over a work dress, sleeves pushed up, stands with both hands still above a tub of steaming water. Middle: a cloth over the tub rim, a plate in one hand. Background: a whitewashed wall, steam, one black iron stove with a red door, firelight through it. Close on the hands and the steam.

Foreground: Sorcha, about fifty, a dark shawl over a work dress, sleeves pushed up, wringing a cloth over the tub. Middle: a towel on the rim, a wet plate in her hand. Background: the long pine table with exactly four wooden chairs, the far-end one set with a bowl, a spoon and a cup. Light: firelight and early dark outside.

A wet cloth wrung out over a tin tub, water running back into the water, on a scrubbed board. Middle: a plate drying on a folded cloth beside it, a spoon. Background: a whitewashed wall and a black iron stove with its red door throwing low red firelight. Nobody in the picture.

A long pine table with exactly four wooden chairs, one at each place. Middle: the far-end chair set with a bowl, a spoon and a cup, the other three places bare. Background: a black iron stove with its red door and a whitewashed wall, warm lamplight along the boards. Nobody in the picture.

Foreground: Ilma, about eleven, dark hair loose, a coat over a nightgown, barefoot, knocking on a low door with her knuckles. Middle: the door of a room under the school, one step, wet grass. Background: the school wall, a shuttered window, rain. Light: one small lamp and black night.

Wilf, nine, dark wet hair flat on one side, bare feet wet to the knees, sits in the fourth chair at a long pine table with his back to the door. Middle: a long dish of rice pudding, a spoon, a towel over the chair back. Background: the mill door open on a black night, a lamp on the wall. Seen from the level of the table.

Foreground: Sorcha's hands wrapping a towel round Wilf's shoulders and turning his wet collar down. Middle: Wilf, nine, dark wet hair flat on one side, bare feet, in the fourth chair. Background: the long pine table with exactly four wooden chairs, Elin, twenty, auburn hair pinned back, a bright blue woollen dress. Light: firelight on the wet shirt.

Foreground: warm milk in a boy's two hands, a loaf on the boards. Middle: Wilf, nine, dark wet hair flat on one side, bare feet up to the black iron stove with its red door. Background: the long pine table with exactly four wooden chairs, Ilma asleep on a bench end, boots on, a lantern on the step. Light: firelight.

Foreground: Elin, twenty, auburn hair pinned back, a bright blue woollen dress, at the table end; Sorcha, about fifty, a dark shawl over a work dress, setting it. Middle: the long pine table with exactly four wooden chairs, a bowl, a spoon and a cup at two places. Background: the black iron stove with its red door. Light: morning sun. Seen over a shoulder, the back of a head in the near foreground.

Foreground: the fourth wooden chair pushed in against the wall, a hand flat on its top rail, a broom on the boards. Middle: bare swept floorboards, one chair leg, the wall a hand's width off. Background: the mill kitchen wall, a peg with a coat, the black iron stove with its red door. Light: plain morning sun through the window.

Foreground: Elin, twenty, auburn hair pinned back, a bright blue woollen dress, in the fourth chair with rice pudding. Middle: Ilma, about eleven, dark hair, a knitted vest over her dress, turned toward her asking. Background: exactly four wooden chairs at the long pine table, the black iron stove with its red door. Light: afternoon light.
